navigation_candidate.conversion: West longitude sign only; no reprojection or datum transformation.

records.center_definition: Authors identify the center from a dated SST image; fitting operator, resolution and position uncertainty are unspecified.
records.source_locator: Section 5.4 discussion of the March 1997 survey and the 24 March 1997 SST image; first of two warm-eddy centers.
records.qualification: Historical source-reported location only. The explicit Deviant/LC ring D name supplies a source-case alias; a nearby second warm eddy is not assigned that name. Coordinate rounding is preserved and is not an accuracy estimate. Not a tracked trajectory, current location, eddy boundary, diameter, uncertainty ellipse or state-containment result.
